name: zeromind
description: ZeroMind for Cursor: connects Cursor to the ZeroMind MCP server at origozero.ai/mcp. The agent writes and runs Luau in the Zero engine, edits the world's files, runs the world, takes screenshots and publishes a game that plays in a browser tab. Link the machine once with `zeromind link` from the `@origozero/zeromind` npm package.
